summary_en: Reviews ultrasound/photoacoustic imaging strategies for guiding and monitoring cancer immunotherapy, including endogenous functional contrast, exogenous molecular and cellular contrast agents, photoimmunotherapy, adoptive-cell therapy, checkpoint blockade, focused-ultrasound immunomodulation, and complementary multimodal imaging. It is relevant as a current synthesis of US/PA multimodal imaging but is not a new image-formation or reconstruction method.
